shared_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production game item sprite for a Rust roguelike. Create ORIGINAL low-resolution pixel art authored on a 32x32 logical pixel grid, displayed enlarged with exact crisp square pixels. Each mark belongs to that grid. Single isolated object centered, entirety fits inside a 26x26 logical pixel bounding box with at least 3 pixels transparent padding on all sides. 3/4 slightly top-down inventory view; diagonal tools may point bottom-left to top-right. Worn utilitarian post-apocalyptic look, restrained highlights, strong recognizable silhouette, a dark outline, compact 4-7 colors, no tiny noise. Real transparent background and transparent empty padding, no cast shadow, no floor, no checkerboard, no text, no numbers, no border, no extra objects. Palette ONLY these Ash & Rust colors: #0E1113 #1A2023 #2B3335 #465256 #718080 #A5AFAB #D0CDBB #F0E6CC #302A24 #534133 #7A5B40 #A8875B #572C27 #8A4333 #B96340 #E78B4B #1E302A #3C5140 #64704B #99A06B #405039 #7B8D45 #B7C878 #DCE3AA #192E3B #34586A #5B8991 #A8CCCA #49232D #A33E47 #E5BD63 #E5F3DF.
